name: Notch Pay

spans: The services are for businesses, associations and sole traders established in Cameroon, represented by an adult with authority to bind them.
Depending on account type and transaction volumes, we may require:
Make sure to have your business registration documents ready before starting the registration process.

open_questions: Notch Pay's merchant agreement (https://notchpay.co/policies/merchant-agreement, last updated 1 November 2026) reserves the services to businesses, associations and sole traders established in Cameroon, while its compliance page (https://developer.notchpay.co/security/compliance) lists KYC for 'Individual Accounts'. Neither says whether a sole trader must be registered, nor whether an individual without a registered business can open a merchant account.
The merchant agreement covers Cameroon only; no Notch Pay page found says who can open an account in CI, SN, KE, UG or GH.

description: Notch Pay is a payment gateway enabling businesses to accept and send money via mobile money (MTN MoMo, Orange Money, M-Pesa, Wave, Airtel) across Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Kenya, Uganda and Ghana. Each market settles in its local currency (XAF in CM; XOF in CI/SN; KES, UGX, GHS).
example_prompt: Add Notch Pay checkout to accept MTN MoMo and Orange Money payments in Cameroon.
